sentences.en: The school is near my house.
There is a big park in the town.
The shop is on the other side of the road.
My room is on the second floor.
The river runs through the city.
There are many trees around the house.
The station is far from here.
We live in a quiet place.
sentences.zh: 我们住在一个安静的地方。

sentences.en: The sea is to the east of the town.
